# seerr_arr_connection_test (Resource)

Test a Radarr or Sonarr connection using `/api/v1/settings/{service}/test`. The API key is sensitive in Terraform output, but Terraform still stores it in state; protect state access and backups. Destroying this action resource does not change Seerr settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "arr_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "seerr_arr_connection_test" "radarr" {
  service  = "radarr"
  hostname = "radarr.example.net"
  port     = 7878
  api_key  = var.arr_api_key
  use_ssl  = true
  base_url = "/radarr"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `hostname` (String)
- `port` (Number)
- `service` (String)
- `use_ssl` (Boolean)

### Optional

- `base_url` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String) Changing a value re-runs the connection test.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `response_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON response from the Seerr test endpoint, including connection profiles, root folders, tags, and version-specific fields.
